research.name: Interdisciplinary Institute of Political Economy (IIEP - UBA - CONICET)
research.summary:
Currently assisting in projects leveraging unstructured text data and Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract inflation expectations.
Recently assisted in gathering information for the fine-tuning process of the LLM, which then is transformed into a quantitative indicator through Natural Language Inference (NLI).
Work under the coordination of José Daniel Aromí (Ph.D., University of Maryland).

projects.name: BCRA_bot
projects.summary:
I developed a Twitter bot (@BCRA_bot) that tweets daily updates of Argentina's monetary statistics, together with weekly and monthly analyses. Data is gathered using the Central Bank of Argentina (BCRA)'s official API.
The bot is hosted in Google Cloud Platform, and run with Google Cloud Scheduler.

projects.name: EcoBici
projects.summary: I conducted a comprehensive data analysis of EcoBici, the public bike-sharing program of Buenos Aires to assess how, when and why people use the service. It includes mapping of most popular rides, as well as a thorough analysis. The project is now turning into an impact evaluation approach.

projects.name: Ma-py-tas
projects.summary: Along the years, I created multiple maps as part of a geospatial data science project I proposed to myself. The topics included are diverse, and so are the formats of data: from a simple GeoJSON to web scraping latitudes and longitudes, and everything in between.

projects.name: Econ
projects.summary: I conducted multiple data analyses of economic data, whether in the form of personal side-projects or by-products of ongoing research. This is a collection of a tiny fraction of those analyses.
